records.outcome: the plugin's public GitHub repo has been filed through the claude.ai in-app submission form and awaits a directory listing decision
preconditions: the plugin repo is public on GitHub; closed-source plugins are not accepted
signed in to a claude.ai Team or Enterprise organization with directory management access (Organization Owners have it by default; on Enterprise an Owner can delegate it through a custom role)
the plugin complies with the Anthropic Software Directory Terms and Policy
steps: Run `claude plugin validate` to check formatting and structure
Sign in to claude.ai with directory management access
Share the GitHub link to your plugin in the submission form
Submit the form and wait for review

evidence.quote: requires a Team or Enterprise organization and directory management access. Organization Owners have this by default

records.notes: client: claude-web; The validate step and the public-repo requirement are stated just above under '## Submitting your plugin'. Review times vary with queue volume; updates pushed to the repo after publication do not require re-submission.

coverage_notes: The only actionable content is the '## Submitting your plugin' section: two parallel in-app submission forms (claude.ai admin settings and Console) plus the post-submission status page. The rest of the unit — distribution options, Community vs. Anthropic Verified, what makes a good plugin, SETUP.md, directory terms, and security best practices — is conceptual or advisory with no steps, or links out to Claude Code docs.
